facebook.text:
Crew Teacher 是我做的 AI 教師 App，可以讓人和 AI 老師對話。網頁版會先打招呼，Android 版卻常常等我先說。

我追到一個原因：Android WebView 啟動麥克風時，會先出現一小段暖機雜音。舊判斷太敏感，可能把它當成我已經開口，AI 的招呼就被跳過。

現在程式要累積 240 毫秒的語音，才把它當成有人先說；中間最多容許 80 毫秒停頓。也加了開場決策和第一段音訊狀態，方便查聲音到底有沒有開始播。

改動已經進到程式，但我還沒把 Android 真機重測當成驗收完成。原來不是 AI 在裝忙，可能是麥克風一開機先搶答。

candidates.topic: Crew Pocket stopped injecting Role Skills by keyword match

evidence.label: Crew Pocket merge commit for PR #129: Agent-selected Role Skill discovery with persistent SKILL.md

claims.text: The production path no longer uses keyword matching to inject a full Role Skill; the current Agent can inspect verified options and fetch full Markdown on demand.
Only manually verified and activated skills enter the catalog, and approved skills can persist as SKILL.md across restarts.
The new path avoids a second model invocation.

candidates.reader_context: Crew Pocket is an Android workspace for managing AI roles and projects; a Role Skill is a role-specific instruction manual.
candidates.story_spine: The app used keyword overlap to choose and inject role instructions → similar words do not prove that a manual applies → the working Agent now inspects approved options and reads a manual only when needed.

decision.reason: This changes a real AI workflow from keyword guessing to an inspectable, on-demand choice that is relevant to agent users.

truth.reason: The merged PR describes manual activation, Agent-selected retrieval, and persistent SKILL.md files.

interest.reason: Keyword overlap could supply an irrelevant instruction, a concrete failure mode in role setup.

personal_relevance.reason: This is a real change in the author’s Crew Pocket role-skill routing.

opening.reason: The opener explains Crew Pocket and Role Skills before discussing the implementation.

Crew Pocket 是我用來管理多個 AI 角色和專案的 Android 工作台。每個角色都能有自己的技能手冊。
